clinical.citation: Yamada et al. 2020 - A recurrent PJA1 variant in trigonocephaly and neurodevelopmental disorders (PMID: 32530565)

variants.description: De novo truncation variant in ZMYND8 (exact nucleotide/protein notation not given in abstract)
phenotypes: Neurodevelopmental disorder (individual phenotype not specified in abstract)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo truncation variant identified by exome sequencing in a cohort of NDD patients (ZMYND8 proposed as novel candidate NDD gene)

model_organism.citation: RACK7 Interacts with PRC2 Complex to Regulate Astrocyte Development (PMID: 40125808)
phenotypes: Rack7 (Zmynd8)-deficient mice exhibit overt developmental defects
Deletion of Rack7 in astrocytes markedly decreases genome-wide H3K27me3 chromatin localization
Altered SUZ12 and H3K27me3 genomic localization
Overactivation of Wnt signaling and astrocyte differentiation genes

model_organism.citation: Zinc finger MYND-type containing 8 promotes tumour angiogenesis via induction of vascular endothelial growth factor-A expression (PMID: 25117453)
phenotypes: In vivo ZMYND8 knockdown suppressed angiogenesis in zebrafish prostate cancer xenografts
ZMYND8 induced vegfa mRNA expression selectively in prostate cancer xenografts

model_organism.citation: ZMYND8 Expression in Breast Cancer Cells Blocks T-Lymphocyte Surveillance to Promote Tumor Growth (PMID: 33148660)
model_organism.knockout_type: other (ZMYND8 knockout in breast cancer cells implanted in syngeneic mice)
phenotypes: ZMYND8 KO tumor cells showed increased micronuclei and DNA damage, with cGAS-STING/NF-κB activation and IFNβ/ISG induction in tumors
Increased CD4+ and CD8+ T cell infiltration
Tumor growth inhibition in syngeneic mice, attenuated by CD4/CD8 depletion, anti-IFNAR1 antibody, and in Rag1 KO mice

model_organism.citation: Validation of ZMYND8 as a new treatment target in hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 34462784)
phenotypes: ZMYND8 knockdown in HCC cells significantly reduced tumor growth in a nude mouse xenograft model
Knockdown reduced migration and invasion and promoted apoptosis in vitro
model_organism.significance: significant reduction in xenograft tumor growth (p-value not given in abstract)

biological.citation: De Novo ZMYND8 variants result in an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder with cardiac malformations (PMID: 35916866)
biological.summary: Neuronal knockdown of the Drosophila ZMYND8 ortholog decreased habituation learning, consistent with a role in cognition. De novo variants were found in 11 individuals with intellectual disability. PWWP-domain missense variants abolish the Drebrin interaction, and MYND-domain variants disrupt the GATAD2A interaction. ZMYND8 is broadly expressed in brain, with highest expression in early brain development.
biological.sample_size: 11 unrelated individuals with variants; Drosophila knockdown model

biological.citation: Positive Regulation of Transcription by Human ZMYND8 through Its Association with P-TEFb Complex (PMID: 30134174)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 binds CyclinT1 directly to form a minimal ZMYND8-P-TEFb complex that activates target genes and is needed for ATRA-mediated neuronal differentiation. Through its coiled-coil domain, the ZMYND8 homodimer associates with P-TEFb, whereas the monomer associates with CHD4 of the NuRD repressor complex.

biological.citation: ZMYND8 suppresses MAPT213 LncRNA transcription to promote neuronal differentiation (PMID: 36064715)
biological.summary: In ATRA-differentiated neuronal cells, ZMYND8 promotes expression of the canonical MAPT coding isoform and epigenetically silences the non-coding MAPT213 isoform. ZMYND8 deletion raised MAPT213, and ectopic MAPT213 repressed the MAPT coding transcript.

biological.citation: ZMYND8 Is a Regulator of Sonic Hedgehog Signaling in ATRA-Mediated Differentiation of Neuroblastoma Cells (PMID: 38804064)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 knockout reduced SHH pathway genes GLI1 and PTCH1 during ATRA-induced differentiation. ZMYND8 co-occupies their promoters with RNA pol II S5P and counteracts the SMO inhibitor cyclopamine, enhancing neurite formation.

biological.citation: ZMYND8 mediated liquid condensates spatiotemporally decommission the latent super-enhancers during macrophage polarization (PMID: 34764296)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 forms liquid condensates with acetylated NF-κB/p65, is redistributed onto latent super-enhancers, and recruits LSD1 to silence them and restrain macrophage inflammation. Mutations that solidify the condensates abolish this function.

biological.citation: The Chromatin Reader ZMYND8 Regulates Igh Enhancers to Promote Immunoglobulin Class Switch Recombination (PMID: 30293785)
biological.summary: In B cells ZMYND8 binds promoters and super-enhancers, including the Igh 3'RR. ZMYND8 loss increases polymerase loading at the 3'RR, decreases acceptor region transcription, and impairs class switch recombination and somatic hypermutation.

biological.citation: Targeting ZMYND8 unleashes IL-2 signalling to override T cell exhaustion (PMID: 42778612)
biological.summary: In vivo single-cell CRISPR screens showed ZMYND8 is induced by chronic antigen and represses p300-mediated Il2ra enhancer activity, which limits IL-2R-STAT5 signalling and promotes terminal exhaustion. ZMYND8-deficient CD8+ T cells had improved antiviral and antitumour function.

biological.citation: Targeting the histone reader ZMYND8 inhibits antiandrogen-induced neuroendocrine tumor transdifferentiation of prostate cancer (PMID: 40102673)
biological.summary: A CRISPR-Cas9 screen combined with scRNA-seq showed ZMYND8 drives NEPC transdifferentiation. ZMYND8 is upregulated by ASCL1, and FOXM1 stabilizes its chromatin binding. It interacts with SWI/SNF, and the inhibitor iZMYND8-34 blocks NEPC development. Zmynd8 ablation prevents NEPC.

biological.citation: ZMYND8 protects breast cancer stem cells against oxidative stress and ferroptosis through activation of NRF2 (PMID: 38488001)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 stabilizes NRF2 through KEAP1 silencing and recruits NRF2 to antioxidant gene promoters, reducing ROS and ferroptosis in ALDHhi breast cancer stem cells. NRF2 in turn controls ZMYND8 expression, forming a positive feedback loop.

biological.citation: USP7 deubiquitinates epigenetic reader ZMYND8 to promote breast cancer cell migration and invasion (PMID: 39128723)
biological.summary: USP7 binds the ZMYND8 PBP domain and removes FBXW7-catalyzed polyubiquitin at K1034, stabilizing ZMYND8. This raises transcription of ZEB1 and VEGFA and promotes migration and invasion. USP7 and ZMYND8 protein levels correlate in breast cancer tissue.
